title: Native support for the managed resolution-constructor finding

claims.Finding: Native FVECTOR2 constructor consists only of mov rax,rcx and ret. It does not initialize either component. The BaseSimpleForm constructor calls it for32 stack entries before querying resolutions.
claims.Limitations: Static native constructor body only; the caller's actual stack contents and available display modes were not observed.

claims.Finding: Resolution wrapper preserves the caller buffer/count/aspect-filter, obtains the GX singleton through11C150, and dispatches11C970. It is not a harmless offline pure function: singleton acquisition can initialize native renderer state.
claims.Limitations: Static wrapper ABI. No call was made and no display setting was changed.

claims.Finding: Resolution enumeration copies at most the caller's capacity and normally returns the number written. If zero entries were written, it recursively calls itself with aspect filtering disabled, discards the recursive return count and forces return1. The fallback has no separate guard when filtering was already disabled, so no eligible mode (or zero capacity with eligible modes) can follow an unbounded recursive path. Returned1 does not establish that exactly one vector was written.
claims.Limitations: Observed machine-code path only. No runtime reproduction, display-mode manipulation or inferred frequency. Eligible native modes are >=800x600 and optionally exact16:9.
